# CONTXT replay harness

Purpose: replay recorded audio or a timestamped transcript through the CONTXT pipeline and score the run.

Install:
npm install

Offline fixture:
npm run replay -- --fixture samples/demo.json

Faster fixture:
npm run replay -- --fixture samples/demo.json --speed 4

Local audio:
npm run replay -- recording.wav --speed 4 --transcriber whisper

Cloud transcription (keys from env; see .env.example):
npm run replay -- recording.opus --transcriber assemblyai [--cloud-model universal-3-5-pro]
npm run replay -- recording.opus --transcriber deepgram [--keyterm Name ...]
npm run transcribe -- recording.opus --provider assemblyai --out fixture.json --raw raw.json

Missing cloud keys are skipped gracefully. AssemblyAI defaults to universal-3-5-pro with speaker_labels; Deepgram defaults to nova-3 with diarize, smart_format, punctuate, utterances.

Debate sample with speakers:
npm run ci:debate   (samples/debate1992.json, 5 named speakers)

Agent API:
import { runReplay } from "contxt-replay-harness";
await runReplay({ inputPath: "samples/demo.json", speed: 4 });

Optional runReplay fields:
transcriber: fixture | whisper | assemblyai | deepgram
modelPath: local whisper.cpp model path
researchFixture: path to mock research JSON
outRoot: output directory root
runId: stable run identifier
stages: replacements for any pipeline stage
cloudModel: cloud model override
keyterms: keyterm prompts for cloud transcribers

Outputs:
out/<run-id>/claims.json   (each claim with speaker, startMs, endMs, topicId)
out/<run-id>/deck.html
out/<run-id>/timeline.json
out/<run-id>/scorecard.json

Checks:
npm test
npm run ci:replay
npm run ci:debate
